# Infinite Red — account brief

## Who

Infinite Red is a consultancy specializing in React Native app design and development ([source](https://infinitered.com/)). Its GitHub org lists 150 public repos and 2100 followers ([source](https://github.com/infinitered)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `infinitered/ignite` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in `infinitered/ignite` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- `infinitered/ignite` last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)).
- The homepage links a careers page ([source](https://infinitered.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@infinitered-maintainer-1), 310 commits, top contributor to `infinitered/ignite`; profile lists company Infinite Red, location Remote, website https://infinitered.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Infinite Red. Maintains Ignite (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@infinitered-maintainer-2), 188 commits; profile lists company Infinite Red, location New York, NY, website https://infinitered.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Infinite Red mobile team. EAS builds and releases for Ignite." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@infinitered-maintainer-3), 97 commits; profile lists company Infinite Red, location San Francisco, CA, website https://infinitered.com, and bio "Engineer at Infinite Red. Mostly Ignite, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-3))

## Why now

`infinitered/ignite` last pushed 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)) and runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/package.json)). The evidence contains no app store listing, so store update cadence is unknown.

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for Ignite ([source](https://github.com/infinitered-maintainer-2)). Ignite carries an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside CI workflows in `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite/tree/main/.github/workflows)), and it was pushed as recently as 2026-08-11 ([source](https://github.com/infinitered/ignite)). Where does the split sit today between those GitHub workflows and EAS when you cut a release for Ignite?
